pr_title: Fix exception in beatmap info overlay
pr_body:
Closes #14541

This adds the missing null coalescence operator that was causing formatting to fail under the scenario where the returned pp value was null, (ie: when the map is loved)
pr_comments: Could this have some sort of testing for the future? The test coverage of the beatmap info overlay is pretty lacklustre (pretty much all online).

Also, as it turns out, there are more places that handle this wrongly, such as:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/7122f48568d2232555f500e4a74e379edd2a337e/osu.Game/Overlays/BeatmapSet/Scores/ScoreTable.cs#L197

With #14563 + the framework changes these become obvious as they raise inspections, so that pull should probably supersede this one and fix all of these issues all at once.

issue_context.title: error after opening the beatmap info overlay on a specific beatmap
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
if i open the beatmap info overlay on [this beatmap](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/580821#osu/1237234) i get an error.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43358824/131215901-329f5890-5388-43ee-81c3-4d32976cc0d6.mp4



**osu!lazer version:** 
2021.828.0

**Logs:**
[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7070593/database.log)
[network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7070594/network.log)
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7070595/performance.log)
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7070596/runtime.log)
[updater.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7070597/updater.log)
comments: I cannot reproduce this failure, and don't understand how a null reference could feasibly be present in the place indicated by the stack trace (which is somewhere [here](https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/blob/758ec3418239d143c491ae92bfa7664ef6a650c1/osu.Framework/Localisation/LocalisationManager_LocalisedBindableString.cs#L28-L51)).

I tried it and it actually crashed my game after showing the error
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7071049/runtime.log)

Update: tried on a fair amount of maps and weirdly enough it also happens on [this map](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/446774)

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/53081750/131224915-048a0375-d8c6-4ddc-bfbe-0bcd7f761faf.mp4

Managed to reproduce while debugging on the aforementionned maps. After a bit of digging aroundl, found out that the error was originating from there:https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/7122f48568d2232555f500e4a74e379edd2a337e/osu.Game/Overlays/BeatmapSet/Scores/TopScoreStatisticsSection.cs#L119

And the reason is somewhat obvious: both mentionned maps are loved, and as such the API return null values for the PP field.

----

Maybe adding a guard framework side to ensure that  formatted strings never end up being null may allow diagnose these issues better I guess.

The logs show that the nullref happened in `LocalisedBindableString.updateValue`? shouldn't it show up in `LocalisableFormattableString.GetLocalised` in that case? if the exception is somehow skipping the first method in the stack trace, then that needs to be fixed as well.

review_comments: For anyone else that might be wondering how on earth this works (because I had zero clue how this fixes anything): It is true that the null-coalescing operator makes it so that the right-hand side expression can be `null`. But there's also an implicit `LocalisableFormattableString -> LocalisableString` conversion here, and `LocalisableString` is tolerant towards null `Data`. So this sorta kinda magically works out.
